footer.about: TWG Construction is a licensed and insured general contractor in Wichita, KS, known to some customers as The Window Guys. We replace roofs, repair hail damage and install siding, windows and doors.
why: Hail damage handled with your insurance company

When hail hits Wichita, homeowners want one company for the roof, the insurance and the clean-up. Your Google reviews say that is you; roofs, hail and insurance come up most. One wrote, "They worked with the insurance company to get the money needed for repairs."

Your website never says roofing. Its top line says "Remodeling & Renovation Contractors", so someone searching for a roofing company in Wichita may never see you. Its phone number also differs from Google's, and two numbers can cost you both calls.
So we built a demo that leads with roofing, gives roof replacement and window replacement their own pages, and shows one number everywhere.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Roofing Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one demo page: what costs you calls, and the fix.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: The top of your homepage says "Remodeling & Renovation Contractors in Wichita, KS" and never says roofing, so Google can't tell a homeowner searching for a roofer that you are one.
Your site's number, 316.776.4748, is not your Google number, (316) 685-1010, so a customer who finds both may call neither.
Your three testimonials are reworded, so they don't match what customers can read on Google.
fixes: A headline that says roofing company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
One number, the one on your Google profile, on every page, one tap to call.
Real reviews, word for word, beside the point each proves.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Roof Replacement
cards.why: Roofs, hail and insurance are what customers write about most.
problems: Your whole site is one page. Roofing shares a few lines with five other services, so Google has no page to show someone searching for roof replacement.
fixes: A full page for roof replacement in Wichita, KS, including hail-damaged roofs.
A section on working with your adjuster, proved by a customer.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Window Replacement
cards.why: Customers call you The Window Guys; your site barely mentions windows.
problems: The Windows & Doors paragraph describes only doors, so someone searching for window replacement finds nothing.
fixes: A page for window replacement in Wichita, KS, that names rotted frames, failed seals and hail damage.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where interest turns into a call.
problems: "Contact Us", "Services" and "About" only scroll down the same page, and /contact, /services and /about say "Page not found".
Your site says Suite 102 and Google says #101.
fixes: A real contact page, with one number that matches Google, and no address until you confirm the suite.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

onboardingQuestions: Who owns TWG Construction, and may we name the owner? Owner replies are signed "Scott" and reviewers name Scott and Brad Randall, but no source says either one owns it.
Phone: which number do we publish? Google shows (316) 685-1010 and the site shows 316.776.4748. We used the Google number. What is the other line?
Address: Suite 102 (the site) or #101 (Google, GuildQuality, MapQuest), and the ZIP? None is shown on the demo.
Years: the site says "since 1986", "30+ years" and "nearly four decades". Is 1986 right?
Full list of services: decks and fences, gutters (one review mentions them), interior work, metal roofing, and windows (the site describes only doors).
Licensing, insurance and the 100% Satisfaction Guarantee: what are the license numbers and the guarantee terms?
Siding warranty: which siding lines carry lifetime manufacturer warranties?
Hours and an email address to show on the contact page.
Is the BBB rating real? A web summary said A+ for The Window Guys, but the BBB page did not load.
Are TWG Construction and The Window Guys the same company? Suite numbers differ on some listings (#102 and #103).
